claims: Max Dowman was born on 31 December 2009.
Max Dowman is an English footballer.
Max Dowman plays as a midfielder for Arsenal.
As of March 14, 2026, Max Dowman is 16 years and 73 days old.
Max Dowman became the youngest-ever goalscorer in Premier League history on March 14, 2026.
Max Dowman became the youngest Premier League goalscorer on March 14, 2026, at 16 years and 73 days.
Max Dowman is the youngest goal-scorer in UEFA Youth League history at 14 years, 8 months.
Max Dowman made his first-team debut in a pre-season friendly against AC Milan on July 23, 2025.
Max Dowman was 15 years old at the time of his first-team debut on July 23, 2025.
Max Dowman joined the Arsenal youth academy in 2015.
